title: Professional Certificate in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
subject: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
description: Practical AI curriculum covering exploratory data science, supervised & unsupervised machine learning, deep learning with PyTorch, computer vision, and modern Generative AI/LLM applications.
prerequisites: Python programming foundations and basic linear algebra/statistics.
target_audience: Software Engineers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Practitioners.

modules.title: Data Science Foundations with NumPy & Pandas
lessons: Vectorized Computing & Array Operations with NumPy
Data Manipulation & Feature Engineering with Pandas

modules.title: Classical Machine Learning Algorithms
lessons: Decision Trees, Random Forests & Ensemble Methods
Unsupervised Learning: K-Means & PCA Dimensionality Reduction

modules.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks with PyTorch
lessons: Building Deep Learning Models with PyTorch
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for Image Recognition

modules.title: Generative AI, Large Language Models & RAG
lessons: Prompt Engineering & Structured Outputs with Gemini API
